title: Baltimore County Council: About
key_finding: Baltimore County says there are no incorporated towns, villages, municipalities, or other political subdivisions in the County.

title: Maryland Local Government
publisher: Department of Legislative Services / Maryland General Assembly
key_finding: The State's local-government reference says Baltimore County has no municipalities and describes Owings Mills as a county business center rather than a municipality.

title: U.S. Census Bureau QuickFacts: Owings Mills CDP Maryland
key_finding: The Census Bureau identifies the target geography as Owings Mills CDP, Maryland, confirming CDP rather than incorporated-place status.

title: Baltimore County Police 2019 Annual Report
key_finding: Baltimore County Police annual materials identify Precinct 3 - Franklin as an active county precinct and tie it to the Owings Mills area.

title: Investigation Follows Owings Mills Incident
key_finding: The official release says Baltimore County Police Department Franklin Precinct officers responded to a call at Rosewood Lane and Reisterstown Road in Owings Mills.

title: Rosewood Center
publisher: Maryland State Archives / Maryland Manual Online
key_finding: Maryland Manual places Rosewood Center at Rosewood Lane, Owings Mills, and says the facility closed on July 1, 2009.
